item.title: NIST Researchers Demonstrate Entangled Photon Transmission Over Existing Fiber Networks
item.summary: Insider Brief In early 2025, special signals wended their way through a fiber-optic highway strung above the streets and sidewalks of the Maryland suburbs. The arrival of those signals at their destination marks a significant step toward a long-held dream of building a “quantum network.” Researchers believe that this emerging technology could someday link quantum […]
